entries.title: EventEase — Campus Event Registration and Check-in Web Demo
entries.subtitle: Product Design and AI-assisted Prototyping | Locally runnable demo
bullets: Turned recurring campus-event friction—scattered registration, manual check-in, and rebuilt attendance records—into one focused workflow for registration, check-in, attendance review, and CSV export.
Defined the core data model around event, participant, signup_status, and check_in_time, then mapped those fields to forms, stored records, status changes, and the export.
Used AI-assisted implementation for pages, routes, and lightweight storage while directing workflow scope, field selection, test cases, acceptance criteria, and functional review.
Added QR-based check-in to avoid an app download and a CSV attendance export for organizers; documented QR-sharing, permissions, and production infrastructure as unresolved limitations.
Ran small-scope tests with classmates and student event organizers, then clarified the duplicate-registration error and added a visible check-in success state based on observed confusion.
